answer: Collateralized vouching. Each member may vouch for at most three newcomers, locking 50 POA per vouch in ninety-day escrow. A newcomer's weight equals the lowest score among its vouchers, so a sybil ring cannot forge depth by vouching for its own hollow fresh accounts. A proven ring link slashes every lock in the cluster. Forging five thousand identities thus needs 250,000 POA frozen across a thousand voucher slots plus ninety days of slashing exposure. The attacker's stake becomes shale, brittle under any audit. Like co-signing a loan: cheap to promise, ruinous to default.
